name: Sparse Feature Volume
definition: A neural implicit scene representation that encodes an entire 3D scene as a sparse feature volume. Each voxel contains a continuous Signed Distance Function (SDF) decoded by a latent vector. The latent vector is fused from multi-view image features and is trilinearly interpolated from the features at the voxel's eight corners. This allows for efficient geometry learning via volume rendering optimization in the space of latent vectors, suitable for online reconstruction.
summary: Sparse Feature Volume represents 3D scenes as a sparse grid of learnable latent vectors, distinguishing itself from dense occupancy fields by combining sparse voxel efficiency with SDF detail preservation.
